prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: essay cover for a restrained personal blog about physics, AI and thoughtful daily life; no lettering will be added inside the image.
Primary request: a quiet abstract editorial illustration of a resilient life portfolio. The essay argues that career, love, health, craft and inner life must retain independent meaning, so no single success or failure holds the whole self hostage. Show a finely balanced sculptural mobile: three distinct simple forms of different shapes and modest sizes hanging on fine charcoal lines, one muted slate-blue circle, one soft sage arch, one dusty-clay quadrilateral, the main thin horizontal bar calmly balanced. One tiny ivory counterweight may create a meaningful hint of room to rebalance. It should convey distributed commitments and calm resilience, not money or stock trading.
Style/medium: refined flat cut-paper editorial art, soft matte ink shapes, a barely perceptible print grain, restrained abstract geometry with delicate line work. No glossy 3D rendering.
Composition/framing: wide horizontal landscape approximately 1.9:1, generous warm ivory negative space all around; the complete small mobile occupies the central half of the image, well clear of all edges, attractive at desktop and phone widths. Simple coherent silhouette, 3 to 5 meaningful shapes at most.
Color palette: warm ivory #F4F1EA background, muted slate-blue #778B99 and sage #A5B1A0 with a very small dusty-clay #C9A18F accent; charcoal #414846 linework. Very low saturation, no stark black or brilliant colors.
Mood: reflective, warm, composed, humane. Subtle natural soft shadow only if needed, no dramatic lighting.
Constraints: a single finished illustration, no panels or collage. No text, lettering, numbers, logo, watermark, decorative border, charts, coins, corporate people, faces, busy details, gradients or fireworks. Keep the forms and lines spare and the image predominantly light ivory.
alt_en: A balanced mobile of distinct shapes, suggesting a life supported by several meaningful commitments
alt_ko: 서로 다른 도형이 균형을 이루는 모빌로 표현한, 여러 의미 있는 영역이 지탱하는 삶
concept: Distinct balanced shapes embody concentration without a single domain monopolising identity, and room for periodic rebalancing.
